# Vendored checkers and third-party material

`marin/` and `upstream/` are byte-for-byte copies of the official IFBench checkers, from Marin's
Evalchemy fork and from upstream IFBench. Do not edit them. `src/ifbench_audit/official.py`
imports both and runs them under one reimplementation of Evalchemy's grading protocol.

| Directory | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `marin/ifbench_marin/` | `marin-community/evalchemy`, `eval/chat_benchmarks/IFBench/` | Marin's checkers. Added in evalchemy#23 (`ab7ae27`, 2026-08-05) and unchanged through `28631c7` (2026-10-16), the commit Marin's main branch pinned when the audit was written. `instructions.py` equals `allenai/IFBench` `357d098` apart from one import line |
| `upstream/ifbench/` | `allenai/IFBench` `1c40f0c` (2026-09-09), `ifbench/` | Upstream main, which includes the six checker fixes of `1d62c1d` |

[`PROVENANCE.md`](PROVENANCE.md), generated by `analysis/provenance.py` from git clones of Marin,
Evalchemy and IFBench, records the evidence: Marin's pin, the commits and their dates, the checker
blobs at each commit, the one-line import difference from upstream `357d098`, the grader
dependencies in Evalchemy's `uv.lock` and how Evalchemy names the dataset.

## Licenses

- The vendored checker files keep their Apache 2.0 headers: Allen Institute for AI for the IFBench
  files, and The Google Research Authors for `upstream/ifbench/classic_instructions.py`. The license
  text is in [`LICENSE`](LICENSE), copied from `allenai/IFBench` at `1c40f0c`.
- Evalchemy publishes no license file, so its own `grader.py` is not redistributed.
  `src/ifbench_audit/official.py` reimplements its strict and loose protocol, and
  `analysis/harness_fidelity.py` compares the two using `grader.py` from a git clone.
- `allenai/IFBench_test` is licensed under ODC-BY-1.0, per the `allenai/IFBench` README, for
  research and educational use under Ai2's Responsible Use Guidelines. The panel archive in
  [release v0.1](https://github.com/XiaoyuanWang111/ifbench-audit/releases/tag/v0.1) and the
  blinded-audit cases (`results/blind_audit/`) contain its prompts.
- The panel archive and the blinded-audit cases also contain responses generated by third-party
  models. Each is subject to its model's license as listed on its Hugging Face card (checked
  2026-10-16): Apache 2.0 for Qwen2.5-7B/14B/32B-Instruct, Qwen3-8B/14B/32B, OLMo-2 (7B, 13B, 32B),
  marin-8b-instruct, Mistral-7B-Instruct-v0.3 and Mistral-Small-24B-Instruct-2501; MIT for phi-4;
  the Llama 3.1 Community License for Llama-3.1-Tulu-3-8B. Each run's manifest records the model
  revision.
- The fixtures (`fixtures/ifbench_fixtures.jsonl`) were written for this audit. The blinded-audit
  reviews (`results/blind_audit/round*/reviews/`) were written by the LLM reviewers that
  `results/blind_audit/README.md` describes.
